summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (MAC Ishaq Material culture/5)

data.turoyo: Bəṯr məd aṯino šġili bu+bayto, fləḥli, šġili bu+bayto ʕam emi, ʕam babi, hēš baḥ+ḥàyene. Karme, šuġlo, mə‿dhowewa.
data.translation: After I came back, I worked at home, I farmed, I worked at home with my mother, with my father, they are still alive. Vineyards, work, whatever there was.

rationale: Thin Preterit/1 cell; first-person agricultural work with the cultivated object omitted and vineyards specified nearby.

summary: The L-series -li marks the first-person actor. The edition’s farmed is broader than a single ploughing operation, but one objectless autobiographical token does not establish a separate lexical sense.

Does objectless fləḥli conventionally mean agricultural work more broadly than ploughing, or does the vineyard context supply the omitted cultivation object? More contrastive evidence is needed before widening the numbered gloss.
Absolute agricultural use with no expressed field object; the following vineyards context supports cultivation rather than a new general-work meaning.
